description_for_human: Free browser roguelite shooter with absurd enemies, archetype perk builds, daily challenges, and global leaderboard rivalry.
description_for_model: Call of Doodie is a free browser-based top-down roguelite wave shooter made by VaultSpark Studios. Players choose a callsign, pick a starter loadout, and survive escalating waves of absurd enemies (Karen, Gym Bro, Mall Cop, etc.). The game features perk-driven archetype builds, daily challenge seeds with global leaderboards, boss rushes, weekly mutations, a replay/challenge system, and in-depth run coaching. It runs entirely in the browser with no install required. Play at https://callofdoodie.wtf/.
